params.body:
Replaces #97: the same change, rebuilt on main after #96 merged, with the migration test of #96 made independent of which migration comes last (it rolled back "the last one", which is this PR's now).

Netwerk showed only what Bouwsoft knows. Relations that matter for the handover are often not in it: the architect who sends the work, a contact person only the owner deals with. And a long section in Contacten jumped from 8 rows straight to "all" (up to 300 of 2,177 clients at once).

## Relations added by hand

- **"Relatie toevoegen"** next to the tabs opens a form:
  - name, municipality and role (client, supplier, contact on a project);
  - optionally "Werkt met", a relation picked by a few letters of its name.
- **After adding:** the relation is opened at once, so its context can be noted right away.
- **In the list and the graph:**
  - it shows in Contacten whatever the period, marked "zelf toegevoegd";
  - it is always in the graph, whatever "Hoeveel" is set to, with a dotted amber line to the relation it works with;
  - its tooltip and panel say who added it, that it is not from Bouwsoft, and who it works with.
- **"Weghalen"** in its panel switches it off (after a confirm). What was told about it stays on Overdracht.
- **Tags and context** work as for any relation.
- **Storage.** Stored in `relations` with `manual`, `manual_role`, `linked_to` and `added_by`, keyed `manual:<random>`. The sync switches off only Bouwsoft relations, so a hand-added one is never touched.

## "Meer laden" in Contacten

- A section shows 8 rows, then 25 more per "N meer laden", with "Minder" and "N van M".
- This replaces "Toon alle", which rendered up to 300 rows at once.

## Tests

- `ManualRelationTest` covers:
  - added with a linked relation and opened;
  - listed as manual;
  - in the graph with a `told` edge even when the limit is 1;
  - a sync leaves it active;
  - a section of 40 clients shows 8, 33, 40, and back to 8.
- `NetworkTest` follows "meer laden".
- `ContextTagsTest` runs its own migration down and up instead of rolling back the last one.
- Full suite 288/288, JS 15/15.
- Walked through in headless Chromium on a copy of the production-size database:
  - add "Architect Vandamme" working with a client: its panel opens, and it is in the graph with its dotted line;
  - Klanten loads 25 more (33 of 2,177).

After merge: `php artisan migrate`.
